demo.title: spend-guardrails.sh
demo.code:
# Ask the policy engine before the wallet spends. No key needed.
curl -s -X POST https://askgrokwallet.io/api/approvals \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"demo","requester":"bankr-agent","summary":"swap 25 USDC for PUMPDUMP","amountUsd":25,"target":"uniswap","assets":["PUMPDUMP","USDC"],"intentKind":"trade","policyText":"trades under $10 run automatically; over $10 ask me; daily budget $50; never trade PUMPDUMP"}'

# Read verdict.verdict from the BODY, never the status code.
#   allow -> HTTP 200, execute.   ask -> HTTP 201, do NOT execute; the human
#   decides at https://askgrokwallet.io/approvals.   deny -> HTTP 200, stop.
#
# Send the identity, not just the venue: target is where (uniswap), assets and
# counterparty are what and with whom. This request is a deny because the asset is
# named -- put the asset only in the summary and it is still caught.
#
# Pass "logResolved": true to keep a receipt for allow/deny decisions. Decisions
# come back signed and are appended to a hash-chained log anyone can verify with the
# released one-file verifier (check the sha256 before running it):
#   BASE=https://github.com/richard7463/askgrokwallet/releases/download/verify-receipt-v1.0.1
#   curl -LO $BASE/verify-receipt.mjs && curl -sLO $BASE/SHA256SUMS
#   shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS && node verify-receipt.mjs receipt.json

setup: Nothing to install — the policy engine is an HTTP endpoint and the demo identity is keyless.
Ask the user for their rules in plain English (or pick a preset from `GET /api/presets`).

Before any spend, `POST /api/approvals` with the plan's identity — `target`, `assets`, `counterparty`, `summary` — and read `verdict.verdict` from the body: `allow` proceeds, `ask` waits for a real human decision at askgrokwallet.io/approvals, `deny` stops.
Never self-approve and never re-cut a denial. An approval covers one exact request; if the amount, asset, or counterparty changes, ask again.

After execution, keep the two records apart: the signed receipt says what was authorised and decided. The payment is confirmed by the transaction you check yourself — a four-tick receipt is not proof that money moved.
Keep Bankr's own spending limits and confirmations on. This skill is a check that runs before your wallet, not a limit installed inside it.
